extracted_content.content: As a Medicare Advantage plan, we have developed payment policies to explain coverage more fully for services. reimbursement_guidelines.title: Reimbursement Guidelines
reimbursement_guidelines.content:
As a Medicare Advantage plan, we have developed payment policies to explain coverage more fully for services. In addition to the policy, claims payments are subject to other plan requirements for the processing and payment of claims, including, but not limited to, requirements of medical necessity and reasonableness and applicable referral or authorization requirements.

The tests listed below ARE REIMBURSABLE for any of the following conditions:

Nucleic acid amplification (NAAT) or polymerase chain reaction (PCR)-based identification of Gardnerella vaginalis (CPT code 87511, CPT code 87512)

NAAT or PCR-based identification (CPT code 87661) of Trichomonas vaginalis

PCR based identification of Candida (CPT code 87481, CPT code 87482)

Screening for Trichomonas (CPT code 87661) IS REIMBURSABLE for any of the following risk factors:

For all other situations not discussed above^, the following tests (CPT code 82120, CPT code 87481, CPT code 87511, CPT code 87512, CPT code 87661) ARE NOT REIMBURSABLE.

Direct probe deoxyribonucleic acid (DNA)-based identification of Candida (CPT code 87480), Gardnerella (CPT code 87510) and Trichomonas (CPT code 87660) IS NOT REIMBURSABLE.

Rapid identification of Trichomonas by enzyme immunoassay (CPT code 87808) IS NOT REIMBURSABLE.

Broad molecular panels designed to concurrently test for vaginitis and various other STIs (CPT code 0330U, CPT code 0505U, CPT code 0557U) IS NOT REIMBURSABLE. ^For additional allowed situations in which CPT code 87481 will approve, please see Laboratory - Onychomycosis Testing
